 The Inner Circle 38 And ONE Friday Fights 178 – Results And Highlights For Every Match 
 After kicking off its blockbuster November 2026 lineup with an explosive triple-header weekend, the action continues with The Inner Circle 38 and ONE Friday Fights 178.
 The world’s largest martial arts organization will broadcast The Inner Circle 38 and ONE Friday Fights 178 live in Asia primetime from Bangkok’s iconic Lumpinee Stadium this Friday, November 13.
 Fans will be treated to the opening round of the highly anticipated 2026-2027 ONE Flyweight Muay Thai World Grand Prix.
 In the main event of The Inner Circle 38, #2-ranked flyweight Muay Thai contender Rodtang “The Iron Man” Jitmuangnon will make his long-awaited return against his Thai compatriot, #3-ranked Nong-O Hama, in a pivotal quarterfinal matchup.
 View this post on Instagram 
 Right after, ONE Friday Fights 178 begins, and the show will open with another quarterfinal matchup, as #4-ranked Shimon Yoshinari will go head-to-head with #5-ranked Ramadan “The Scorpion” Ondash.
 Then later, in the main event, Rodtang’s teammate, Superlek Jitmuangnon, will square off against Azerbaijani mauler Anar Mammadov in bantamweight Muay Thai action.
 Plus, two dozen Muay Thai and MMA rising stars will compete for a chance to earn a life-changing US$100,000 contract and coveted spot on ONE Championship’s global roster.
 For up-to-the-minute results and video highlights from every match at The Inner Circle 38 and ONE Friday Fights 178, check below.
